scope: Read-only analysis of retained v12 failures; v13 implementation is limited to a separately reviewed capacity preview.

observation_method.sqlite: URI mode=ro with explicit BEGIN; no Store initialization
observation_method.packet: Existing _capacity_packet and _review_messages with a read-only Store facade; no Provider generation or payload admission
observation_method.cost_unit: UTF-8 bytes; model usage counters are reported tokens and are not byte estimates
observation_method.wire_measurement: Compact JSON of _review_messages using the literal placeholder system content SYSTEM; excludes the actual review policy, schema and Provider payload framing

execution.counter_difference_explanation_status: not established by this read-only analysis; do not infer an unsettled Gateway attempt

findings: Existing constraint projection already removes about five kilobytes of duplicate representation in each run.
The original goal is distinct text, so deleting it by treating the original request as an exact substitute is not lossless.

Artifact and delivery prose overlap semantically but no measured delivery string of at least 64 bytes occurs exactly or as a substring in the artifact. Removing such prose would change evidence content.
The ideal duplicate-string savings are upper bounds before reference metadata; they are too small to resolve the retained L3 capacity deficit.
The raw packet cap is checked before wire projection; improving only _review_messages does not remove a raw-packet rejection.

A future artifact-writing contract can place complete conclusions once in the artifact and keep the delivery to concise status and exact artifact/receipt references. Historical content must remain intact.

planner_preflight_design.implementation_status: not implemented; explicitly deferred beyond the current preview scope
planner_preflight_design.current_gap: Planner sees original request text and model inventory, but not verified input-file byte metadata or structured per-node source assignments.
planner_preflight_design.required_new_contract: Optional required_input_paths on new node proposals, defaulting to an empty list for legacy/manual compatibility; new autonomous plans bind paths to a verified inventory or declared predecessor artifacts.
planner_preflight_design.inventory: Collect bounded local paths explicitly supplied by the user; apply the existing workspace/sensitive-path/file limits; compute actual bytes, canonical JSON-string bytes and SHA-256. Treat manifest path/bytes/hash entries as untrusted claims and recheck them. Do not use repository source_bytes as the size of an excerpt input.
node_checks: Calculate an immutable review-input floor using the same representation and Provider payload accounting as runtime; include original contracts, selected source receipts and tool/schema framing.

Require a complete Worker admission envelope plus initial review and, when the approved contract permits a correction, one revision-request envelope and a second complete review. Report each component. This is a declared planning reserve policy, not a theorem about unknown model usage.

Reject a projected single request that cannot fit the selected context. Return the numeric violation through the existing one-repair Planner loop; do not silently shrink assigned requirements or increase an allowance.
Resolve output sizes only from explicit new artifact/delivery contracts. Unknown sizes remain unknown; do not invent compactness guarantees or truncate required final reports.
Recheck against the selected approved model and role contract at composition/admission because Planner inventory alone does not choose the final model.
global_checks: For each applicable Gateway scope, compute charged plus unresolved reserved plus opening tokens using the existing ledger accounting; remaining is the minimum residual scope allowance.
Require all declared node allocations plus an explicit coordination reserve to fit the remaining approved plan/operator cap. Already incurred Planner/Composer/Router cost cannot be treated as free.
If the envelopes do not fit, reject/replan within the same original cap. Preserve explicitly requested specializations and obtain the existing plan/team approvals for every changed contract.
The runtime Gateway remains the authoritative transactional admission check; preview or preflight grants no budget, tool scope or PASS.
meaningful_tests: Changing input Unicode/quote/backslash bytes changes the computed cost through actual Provider serialization rather than character count.
Tampered manifests, mismatched sizes/hashes, path escape and sensitive paths fail without a Provider call or proposal write.
An underfunded source-heavy node is rejected despite a valid global sum; a corrected allocation within the same cap succeeds after exactly one bounded Planner repair.
Unknown output sizes and future predecessor artifacts are reported as unknown, never zero or guaranteed feasible.
Model-window reduction between plan and composition invalidates the feasibility result without modifying historical approved contracts.
Concurrent unresolved Gateway reservations count against the global floor; no reservation is refunded, settled or increased by read-only estimation.
Legacy/manual proposals and historical PASS packet hashes remain byte-for-byte compatible when the new contract is absent.

checks: Refactored complete _capacity_packet preserved both previously captured raw hashes.
Configured Gateway payload bytes equal preview native-input bytes for both complete retained failures.
Real SQLite URI mode=ro BEGIN prohibited writes; total_changes remained zero after packet and preview calls.
Running preview uses a separate current-approved assignment path and null delivery/event placeholders; complete _packet keeps its original result provenance and state gates.
Unsettled tools/intents/model usage make preview unavailable rather than usable capacity; complete review still performs independent admission.
Worker feedback contains numeric/advisory measurements and is serialized before the existing complete-request reservation calculation.
preview_refactor_review.limitations: This independent review did not execute or duplicate the in-progress focused/full suites and does not replace those checks. Running preview estimates are explicitly neither lower nor upper bounds, since later content can switch the wire representation.

limitations: Component byte counts serialize each value independently and omit its parent key/separator overhead; component sums are not full packet totals.
Duplicate scanning considers exact string leaves of at least 64 UTF-8 bytes after the existing wire projection. It is not a semantic equivalence claim or a general compression bound.
The placeholder-system wire totals are comparative diagnostics, not exact Provider admission reservations.
No original source bodies, user request bodies, credentials, or live response prose are copied into this report.
This report does not establish task acceptance or make any retained failure pass.
